governance_body: Abu Dhabi Public Health Center (ADPHC) & DoH Abu Dhabi

rules.recommended_action: Complete annual/triennial ADPHC IFHAS comprehensive health screening
rules.clinical_rationale: Comprehensive screening evaluates cardiometabolic risks, oral health, mental health, and age-specific cancers.
rules.source_guideline: ADPHC IFHAS Adult Periodic Examination Standard

rules.recommended_action: Obtain formal clinical blood pressure measurement and repeat triage
rules.clinical_rationale: Elevated or overdue blood pressure monitoring prevents undiagnosed hypertension and associated cardiovascular complications.
rules.source_guideline: DoH Abu Dhabi Cardiovascular Health Guidance 2024

rules.recommended_action: Order fasting plasma glucose (LOINC 1558-6) or HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) screening
rules.clinical_rationale: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus screening detects asymptomatic dysglycemia in at-risk adult populations.
rules.source_guideline: ADPHC Diabetes Screening & Management Clinical Guidelines

rules.recommended_action: Schedule basic vitals intake encounter to resolve missing baseline clinical data
rules.clinical_rationale: Clinical risk scoring cannot safely evaluate cardiovascular or metabolic health without baseline measurements.
rules.source_guideline: DoH Preventive Care Quality Standards - Epistemic Safety Invariant
